result.summary: Annotate legacy getter and signing functions that return a boolean success flag alongside mutable out-parameters with the C++17 `[[nodiscard]]` attribute across the codebase. Address callers that previously ignored the return value by asserting success in witness sigop counting, checking descriptor cache return status, and wrapping test iteration in `BOOST_REQUIRE`.
result.problem: Legacy getters using the `bool Get...(..., mut& out)` idiom allow callers to ignore return values and inadvertently use uninitialized or invalid out-parameters when retrieval fails.
evidence: PR description: "To ensure that the 'imaginary optional' is not unwrapped when the getter returns false, add a C++17 `[[nodiscard]]` attribute to all those legacy functions."

Commit 90a82662a9 notes that ignoring the return value of `GetOp` triggers compiler warnings once annotated: `warning: ignoring return value of function declared with 'nodiscard' attribute [-Wunused-result]`
result.scope_notes: Touches diverse subsystems including script interpretation, descriptor caching, wallet interfaces, and networking to add compiler attributes.
result.changed_since_previous: No substantive changes; commits and approach remain unchanged from the previous version.
result.card: This PR adds [[nodiscard]] attributes across the codebase to legacy getter functions that return a boolean success flag alongside mutable out-parameters. It prevents callers from inadvertently ignoring failure status and using invalid out-parameters. The PR also fixes existing call sites where return values were previously ignored, including adding an assertion inside script witness sigop counting and checking cache retrieval results during descriptor evaluation.

risk.why: It introduces an Assert in CountWitnessSigOps within consensus-critical interpreter code; if the invariant on IsPushOnly fails under any condition, nodes would crash.
